Colors.name: color/gray/black
Colors.description: Do not use this color unless specifically noted. Use Grey-Min for almost every situation where "black" is required.

Colors.description: Use for "black" text, icons, elements unless specifically noted otherwise.

Corrected 2026.08.27 to match MNG Design System's confirmed color/tributes/primary-lighter (#F15F87) — the prior UI Style Guide value (#A39C8A) was a row-misalignment error that actually matched the Tan swatch, not this ramp step.

Colors.name: color/theme/primary-darker
Colors.description: Theme primary ramp — darker step, Endless Tributes mode. Corrected 2026.08.27 to match MNG Design System's confirmed color/tributes/primary-darker (#4D0000) — the prior UI Style Guide value (#E8E6E2) was a row-misalignment error that actually matched the Tan-light swatch, not this ramp step.

Colors.name: color/theme/near-black
Colors.description: Theme Neutrals — Near Black (nav labels, UI text, theme-specific). Copied from MNG Design System's Theme collection (Bold Coastal / Modern Earthy / Measured Vibrant) and mapped to each publication mode via its documented "Shared Theme" on MNG's Color Styles page (2026-09-10). UNCONFIRMED placeholder (falls back to gray/min) for modes with no MNG-documented shared theme: DenverPost, Endless Tributes, Morning Call, Boston Herald, Hartford Courant.

Colors.description: Nav text/label color per theme. In MNG Design System this equals color/theme/near-black exactly in every theme, so the same mapping is used here (2026-09-10). UNCONFIRMED placeholder (falls back to gray/min) for modes with no MNG-documented shared theme: DenverPost, Endless Tributes, Morning Call, Boston Herald, Hartford Courant.

CORRECTED 2026-09-10: this description was wrong. Confirmed live today on ocregister.com/sports/ AND chicagotribune.com/sports/ — 40px/700/Noto Serif is a SECTION-FRONT PAGE H1 (className "section-header", e.g. the "Sports" heading atop a section landing page), not a kicker/category label. Type Primitives.name: font/style/regular
Type Primitives.description: "Regular" (weight 400). Figma companion to the matching font weight. In Figma, bind this to a text layer's font style instead of binding the numeric weight: binding the weight makes Figma pick the Noto Sans / Noto Serif Display styles, which production never uses. Code and the token exports keep using the weight.
